verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API/webhook architecture lets fraud decisions run automatically in the background (webhooks fire on guarantee decisions, Sale/Checkout endpoints process orders without manual review), which is a form of background automation, but there is no evidence of an AI-native automation/agent framework, scheduling, or user-configurable autonomous workflows beyond the fixed fraud-review pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit agent/automation builder, user-configurable autonomous triggers or workflows, evidence of AI-agent orchestration rather than fixed API/webhook integration.
